key_highlights: ASX slid to three-month low as banks and miners fell, though intraday recovery saw index finish higher ahead of Fed decision; oil prices jumped on tightening global supply
IMF downgraded Australian GDP forecast citing rate-hike fears; US policymakers signal another Fed hike this year, pressuring AUD and global risk assets
Chinese growth 'sinks from sight' raising demand concerns for iron ore, coal, and LNG exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX, WBC.AX)
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm across construction/property sector; mortgage stress and negative equity hit young Australians
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre in western Queensland; Auric fast-tracks WA Burbanks plant; Barkly rare earths discovery in NT signal resource-sector resilience
Real wages growth crushed by exploited workers; Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse after 58 years, signalling consumer-staple stress
Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports and diesel price spike add inflationary pressure, complicating RBA path

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold grades (Aguia) and rare earths (Barkly) positive; coal resilient; but Chinese growth slowdown pressures iron ore/coal demand. Miners fell in ASX slide.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from China; gold (NVS.AX, GSG.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, AUR.AX) offer relative strength. Coal (BRL.AX, WDS.AX) less vulnerable than feared.

sectors.trend: Banks led ASX decline; mortgage stress and negative equity rising; Bathla insolvency contagion; private credit concerns among wealthy borrowers.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face credit-quality overhang. Rate-hike expectations support NIM but elevate default risk. Monitor NPL trends.

sectors.trend: Crude prices soaring on tightening supply; diesel spike; east-coast fuel distribution crunch; green hydrogen spend questioned.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil strength. Woodside (WDS.AX) LNG exposure supported. Green hydrogen policy risk for WDS.AX, SAI.AX.

sectors.trend: Real wages crushed; Cue and Veronika Maine collapse; Anytime Fitness under scrutiny; consumer spending under pressure.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX, LSG.AX face margin pressure. Discretionary spend weak. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) preferred.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre a structural positive; AI sentiment volatile globally; Nvidia guidance strong but 'AI doom' narrative persists.
sectors.implications: Local data/infra plays (WBC.AX, CGF.AX) benefit. CSL.AX, SGP.AX as quality tech-adjacent names. Global AI capex cycle supports hardware demand.

sectors.trend: Trump policy mulls crashing house prices; mortgage stress and negative equity rising; Bathla insolvency hits construction-linked REITs.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Construction REITs most exposed. Monitor RBA housing commentary.

key_themes: Fed rate-hike cycle pressuring global risk assets and AUD
Chinese growth deceleration as key demand risk for Australian commodity exporters
Domestic credit stress: Bathla insolvency, mortgage negative equity, private credit exposure
Real wage stagnation undermining consumer confidence and retail earnings
Energy supply tightness (oil, diesel) adding inflationary pressure and complicating RBA easing path
Resource-sector diversification: gold, rare earths, and data infrastructure offsetting iron ore/coal cyclicality
Consumer brand fragility: Cue/Veronika Maine collapse signals structural retail weakness

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike / global liquidity tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in fixed income; favour cash-flowing equities; hedge AUD exposure via AUD/USD forwards
Underweight iron ore/coal exposure (BHP.AX, FMG.AX); rotate into gold and critical minerals
Screen construction and property-linked names; monitor bank NPL disclosures; avoid sub-investment-grade credit
Favour integrated energy majors (WDS.AX, BRL.AX); avoid transport/logistics names with fuel-cost exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand erosion / real wage stagnation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shift from discretionary to staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX); reduce retail exposure (WES.AX, LSG.AX)

opportunities.rationale: Record gold grades (Aguia), Barkly rare earths discovery, and safe-haven demand amid Fed tightening and China risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add integrated energy majors on oil strength
opportunities.rationale: Crude soaring on supply tightness; diesel spike supports upstream margins; coal demand resilient

opportunities.recommendation: Position in data-infrastructure and quality healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre signals structural tech capex; CSL/SGP offer defensive quality with growth

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / coal cyclicals; trim bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Chinese growth deceleration and domestic credit stress (Bathla, mortgage negative equity) elevate downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds; hedge AUD
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike cycle and IMF downgrade pressure AUD and global equities; preserve capital
Bathla insolvency storm and housing stress create contagion risk across the sector

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and偏弱 near three-month lows. Fed decision and oil price direction are immediate catalysts. Banks and miners under pressure; energy and gold provide relative support. Expect 3–5% downside risk into month-end if Fed hawks prevail.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots to easing post-Fed cycle. Structural tailwinds from data infrastructure (Anthropic), critical minerals, and healthcare offset cyclical commodity risk. Key variable: Chinese demand recovery and domestic wage growth trajectory.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate and statement (next scheduled meeting)
Chinese PMI / GDP print (demand signal for BHP, RIO, FMG)
Bathla insolvency resolution and contagion spread
Australian CPI and wage data (real wage trajectory)
watch_list: Iron ore (62% Fe) and Brent crude prices
Bathla creditor recovery and construction-sector NPLs
Australian retail sales and CPI (wage-price spiral risk)
Fuel supply / diesel pricing at east-coast ports
